# Refusal codes

Every code `check` and its siblings can emit. `code` is stable — branch on it.
`expected` in the verdict is the concrete fix for that instance; the guidance
column is the general one.

## Refusals (exit 1)

| code | row | meaning | fix |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activation-failed` | activation | activate(ctx) threw or rejected | activate must complete within its deadline and register only declared ids |
| `activation-leak` | activation | deactivation left a timer or handle running (§24.2 leak row) | clear every timer/listener in the disposable activate returns (or ctx.track it) |
| `artifact-hash-mismatch` | registry | `the artifact's sha256 is not what the index pins (PLUGIN_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH)` | re-pack and re-pin: the index pins the bytes, and a mismatch is never installed |
| `artifact-missing` | artifact | the manifest declares an entry module that is not on disk | run `plugin-build`, or fix entries.<renderer\|service> to name what it builds |
| `artifact-unmappable-specifier` | artifact | the bundle imports a bare specifier the host import map cannot bind (§11.6) | `import only HOST_SINGLETON_MODULE_SPECIFIERS, or let the plugin bundle it in` |
| `behavior-presence-budget-exceeded` | manifest | the plugin's charged ephemeral facets exceed one renderer presence window | reduce maxFacetBytes claims or remove optional presence producers; the whole plugin set must fit 48 KiB including per-facet envelopes |
| `behavior-store-unsupported` | manifest | a legacy host release does not admit this behavior store | upgrade the host; current releases admit bounded ephemeral behaviors and no longer emit this code |
| `binding-missing` | activation | `the manifest declares a command, surface or behavior that activate never bound (§12.1); a widget row needs none on the desk build — the host compiles it faceless (DK-2), and an object's binding is its module's export (the object-* codes)` | bind every declared command, surface and behavior during activate(ctx) |
| `binding-undeclared` | activation | activate registered a command, surface or behavior the manifest does not declare (§12.1) — an object's kind is never registered: the host reads binding.kind | declare it in the manifest first, or stop registering it |
| `dev-root-unknown` | dev-link | no dev-linked plugin root could be resolved for this machine | `pass --root <dir>, or run inside the repo whose dev session watches examples/plugins` |
| `docs-stale` | docs | the committed docs are not what the current schemas generate | regenerate with `pnpm gen:docs` and commit the result |
| `harness-error` | harness | the kit itself failed — a bug here, not in the plugin (exit 2) | report it with the detail line; the plugin is not implicated |
| `import-name-unknown` | activation | the built module imports a name its host module does not export — the host's import map links it to that same module, so the plugin would never load | import only what the door exports (a typo, or a name the door withholds: acquire, adopt, the host half, all of /desk/objects) — the detail names the module and the name |
| `index-invalid` | registry | the index bytes are not a RegistryIndex | generate it with the kit; the shape is RegistryIndex in @vibefield/contracts |
| `index-unreadable` | registry | the registry index could not be read from the given path or url | `pass --index <path to index.json>; its detached signature must sit beside it` |
| `key-unreadable` | registry | the signing key file could not be read, or is not a base64 DER Ed25519 secret key | generate one with generateRegistryKeypair(); the file holds the base64 secretKey |
| `link-exists` | dev-link | the target link name is taken by something this command did not create | remove it first, or re-run with --remove to unlink what the kit linked |
| `manifest-invalid` | manifest | the manifest fails PluginManifestV1 — one verdict per zod issue | the verdict's pointer names the failing field; expected states the passing shape |
| `manifest-missing` | manifest | the plugin directory has no vibefield.plugin.json | emit it from src/manifest.ts: `vibefield-plugin emit-manifest <dir>` (in a workspace with an install, `pnpm gen:manifest` does the same) |
| `manifest-source-missing` | manifest | emit-manifest found no src/manifest.ts — the manifest is AUTHORED there (TypeScript) and emitted to JSON | author it in src/manifest.ts as `export const manifest: PluginManifestV1 = { … }` (the scaffold's shape) |
| `manifest-source-unloadable` | manifest | src/manifest.ts did not load in Node, or exports no `manifest` | keep it a plain module: `export const manifest`, `import type` for types, values only from @vibefield/contracts or the SDK — the detail quotes the error |
| `manifest-stale` | manifest | the committed vibefield.plugin.json is not the canonical emission of itself | re-emit it from src/manifest.ts — `vibefield-plugin emit-manifest <dir>` (or `pnpm gen:manifest` with an install); never hand-edit the canonical artifact |
| `manifest-unreadable` | manifest | vibefield.plugin.json is not parseable JSON, or exceeds the manifest byte limit | emit it with plugin-build's emitManifest rather than hand-editing |
| `module-shape-invalid` | activation | the renderer entry's default export has no activate(ctx) function | export default defineRendererPlugin({ activate(ctx) { … } }) |
| `module-unloadable` | activation | the built renderer entry exists but throws while being imported | module top-level must not perform product work (§10.1) — do it in activate(ctx) |
| `object-bind-group-mismatch` | activation | a bind group does not fill its layout exactly — a binding left empty, filled twice, not in the layout, or given the wrong resource | fill every binding of the layout exactly once, each with the resource it asks for (a buffer made for that use, a texture view, a sampler) |
| `object-create-failed` | activation | the kind's create threw, or resolved no KindPass, on a recording device that answers every call as WebGPU does short of compiling | a create that resolves a KindPass (spawn · prepare · drawRange · dispose) from the device, format and mat it is handed |
| `object-dispose-failed` | activation | the kind's pass threw when it was disposed | a dispose that lets go of what the pass made, and never throws |
| `object-export-missing` | activation | an objects row's binding.kind names no ObjectBinding the built renderer module exports (§12.8) | export the binding under that name: `export const <name>: ObjectBinding = { kind }` (@vibefield/plugin-sdk/desk) |
| `object-kind-invalid` | activation | the named export's kind is not a desk kind (ICE isObjectKind: name · stratum · create · resolve · record · hit · reach), or lies in no stratum the ground draws (pads, sheets, things) | type it `ObjectKind` from @vibefield/plugin-sdk/desk and give it every required member |
| `object-kind-misnamed` | activation | the kind's registry name is not the row's type — the host refuses it (one id, no second namespace) | name the kind exactly as the row's type |
| `object-kit-piece-unknown` | activation | the kind's program names a piece the render kit does not carry (`kitWgsl`) | name only the kit's pieces in kitWgsl: view, portal, sdf, light (lamp, gobo, night, noise), ruler, book |
| `object-provides-no-desk-object` | activation | the row does not provide `desk.object` — the desk places by what a row provides, never by its type | provide `desk.object` (DESK_OBJECT) beside the row's own keys |
| `object-tool-inert` | activation | a held tool has an op (`run`) but no `kind` — ICE takes it as DECLARED ONLY: the bar shows it dim and never runs it | give it `kind: "action"` (its op runs once when chosen) or `kind: "mode"` (the active tool) |
| `object-tool-invalid` | activation | one of the kind's held tools (`open.tools`) is not a tool ICE takes at definition — no id or a repeated one, no label, an unknown kind, an action with no op, a glyph it cannot draw | a HeldToolDef: `{ id, label, kind: "action", run(api) }` or `{ id, label, kind: "mode" }`, a glyph a name of the bar's set or `{ path }` (SVG path data in the bar's 24-unit box) — objects.md quotes the type |
| `object-tray-category-invalid` | activation | the row's tray category is empty or longer than the pegboard's 64 characters | a tray category of 1–64 characters — the pegboard's chip |
| `object-tray-hang-missing` | activation | the row's tray entry does not say how its specimen hangs: no size, no accessory the pegboard has, or no pegs | `tray.hang` with w and h (> 0, CSS px), an accessory (hook, shelf, clip, rail) and 1–8 pegs |
| `object-wgsl-binding-unlaid` | activation | a binding a pipeline's stage statically uses is not in that pipeline's layout, or is laid as another kind of resource | carry every binding the WGSL's entry points use in the pipeline's layout, at its @group/@binding, as the same kind of resource |
| `object-wgsl-not-text` | activation | the kind's create asked for a shader module whose code is not WGSL text — the shader did not arrive inlined | import the kind's .wgsl files (plugin-build inlines each as its text) and compose them with kitWgsl |
| `object-wgsl-unread` | activation | a pipeline names an entry point its WGSL does not declare for that stage, or overrides a constant it never declares — read from the text, no compiler | name the entry points the WGSL declares (`@vertex fn vs`, `@fragment fn fs` by default) and override only what it declares |
| `objects-need-desk` | activation | the manifest declares object kinds (contributes.objects) — object kinds need the desk; this build draws widgets (§12.8); said only by the ICE 0.11 build — the desk build (DK-2) activates object kinds and no door says it | kept for the record: on the desk build an object kind activates like any plugin; a host that still says this code predates the desk — run the desk build |
| `onwidget-activation-retired` | manifest | `the retired onWidget:<type> activation event — an object's activation event is onObject:<type> (DK-9)` | `rename it onObject:<type>: it fires when the type's first instance appears in the document (manifest.md)` |
| `pack-refused` | pack | the .vfplugin bundle could not be produced (unsafe entry name, missing entry) | `pack walks vibefield.plugin.json + dist/** + assets/** — keep entries inside them` |
| `plugin-dir-invalid` | input | the path given is not a directory holding a plugin | pass the directory that holds vibefield.plugin.json |
| `release-not-found` | registry | the index carries no entry for the requested plugin id | check the id, or submit the plugin to the index first |
| `schema-invalid` | schema | a declared settings or service JSON Schema does not compile | the schema must compile under ajv (draft-07 style, `strict: false`) as the daemon compiles it |
| `signature-invalid` | registry | the detached signature does not verify against the index bytes | re-sign the EXACT bytes on disk; verification never re-canonicalizes |
| `signature-missing` | registry | no detached index.json.sig beside the index | sign the index with `vibefield-plugin index sign <index> --key <secret>` |
| `systems-contribution-superseded` | manifest | the retired contributes.systems shape cannot express an ICE behavior descriptor | define through @vibefield/plugin-sdk/behavior and declare under contributes.behaviors |
| `try-app-failed` | try | the app's try run ended before it judged every kind (it could not build, start, or reach its desk) | read the app's log (try.log beside the stills); the plugin is implicated only if a row above names it |
| `try-app-missing` | try | no VibeField app beside this kit to launch — try runs the app from the checkout the kit is installed in | run the kit from a checkout of the VibeField repository (its root package.json has smoke:plugin) |
| `try-kind-refused` | try | the desk refused the kind on the host's device — its WGSL did not compile or its pipeline did not build (refused at create), or its world half threw three times (quarantined); its objects wear the missing face | the detail quotes the desk's own reason — for WGSL, the compiler's first line with its place (label:line:column); fix it, rebuild, try again |
| `try-no-objects` | try | the manifest declares no object kind, so there is nothing to lay on the desk | declare the kind under contributes.objects (objects.md) and export what its binding.kind names |
| `try-not-laid` | try | the app's fresh board did not lay one of the plugin's kinds — not registered (its plugin was not staged, or the host refused its row), or not placed | the row must provide `desk.object`; the verdict's detail and the app's log (try.log beside the stills) say which |
| `try-not-picked` | try | the object was laid and its kind made, but nothing of it was picked on the drawn frame | draw where the object lies (resolve → record → the pass), and make hit() answer "content" over what the pass draws — look at the still |
| `try-unbuilt` | try | the renderer entry the manifest names is not on disk — the desk loads the BUILT module | run `plugin-build` in the plugin's directory first (it writes dist/renderer.js) |
| `usage` | input | the command line could not be understood | run `vibefield-plugin --help`; every command is non-interactive |
| `wall-violation` | wall | plugin runtime code imports something outside the SDK door (§11.3, wall R10) | import @vibefield/plugin-sdk (+ /ui, /canvas, /behavior, /desk), @vibefield/contracts types, or react |
| `widgets-contribution-retired` | manifest | the retired contributes.widgets — a face on the desk is an object kind the desk draws (DK-8) | declare it under contributes.objects: its durable half (size, props, groups, interaction) and binding.kind, the renderer export that holds its kind (objects.md) |

## Notes (exit 0)

A note is a row that could not run, or a fact worth saying. It never fails a
command — honest absence beats a blank.

| code | row | meaning | what it suggests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activation-not-loadable-here` | activation | the bundle needs a browser graph (JSX/CSS/ICE) that plain Node cannot import | the playground runs these rows against a real engine; the CLI reports honestly |
| `activation-unbuilt` | activation | no built renderer entry on disk, so binding and leak rows could not run | run `plugin-build` first if you want these rows; `check` never requires a build |
| `artifact-absent` | artifact | no dist/ — artifact rows were skipped, which is not a failure | run `plugin-build` to produce dist/ before packing or publishing |
| `artifact-singleton-build-time` | artifact | duplicate-singleton detection (PA-29) needs the bundler's module list, so it runs in plugin-build, not here | run `plugin-build`; it refuses a bundle that swallowed a host singleton |
| `dev-link-next-steps` | dev-link | what closes the loop after linking — a developer session of the app reads the root (a person's step); `try` draws it without one | re-run dev-link after each build (the copy is what the daemon re-reads); `vibefield-plugin try <dir>` puts its kinds on the desk and says whether each is drawn |
| `dev-root-chosen` | dev-link | which dev-linked root the command used, and why that one | pass --root to choose a different one; the order is flag, env, repo default |
| `link-missing` | dev-link | --remove found nothing to unlink | nothing to do — the plugin is not dev-linked under this root |
| `manifest-dev-alias-id` | manifest | a single-segment dev-era id — valid locally, refused by distribution (§6.1) | use a dotted, distributable id (`vendor.plugin`) before publishing |
| `manifest-unknown-key` | manifest | a top-level or contributes key the schema does not know (preserved, ungranted) | remove it, or land the contribution kind in @vibefield/contracts first |
| `object-create-not-run-here` | activation | the kind's create did not finish on the recording device (it ran past its budget, or reached for a browser global Node does not define) — the harness's ceiling, not a refusal | nothing to do here: the product makes the pass on a real device; the playground drives its states without it |
| `object-wgsl-not-compiled` | activation | the kind's WGSL was READ — its entry points and bindings — never compiled: an unresolved name or a type error passes this row (the honest gap, not a refusal) | run `vibefield-plugin try <dir>`: the app compiles the kind on its device and draws it, and a WGSL error comes back as the compiler's own line (file:line:column) — the Dawn still waits on the pin carrying ICE's createStill (I30) |
| `submit-artifact-url-placeholder` | registry | the emitted index row's artifactUrl is a placeholder, not a real location | replace it with the release asset's url before opening the index PR |
| `submit-index-repo-absent` | registry | the index repository does not exist yet, so submitting is a human step | keep the row; add it to registry/index.json and sign it when the repo exists |
| `try-desk-awake` | try | the desk did not come to rest with the kind on it, and the kind's own due() asks for frames | a kind whose local() ticks answers due(now) with the next time it needs a frame — Infinity when nothing moves (objects.md, Wakes) |
| `try-stills` | try | where the run's stills of the whole board are (each object's own stills are on its row) | look at them: the desk drew what they show, by day and by night |
